dimensions.rationale: Real, explicit, named strategic repositioning choice.

dimensions.evidence_used: merchant count grew from ~20,000 (2010) to over 80,000 (Dec 2013) -- a real, dated, two-point series (approximately 4x over ~3 years)
dimensions.rationale: This is the one dimension across the entire calibration set with a genuine, clean, dated multi-period series in permitted evidence. A defensible numeric score cannot be produced without a rate-to-score conversion function, which does not exist -- this is a pure calibration-function gap, not an evidence gap, and worth flagging as such explicitly.
No company-revenue figures; only GMV exists, which the record itself explicitly distinguishes from revenue.
dimensions.missing_information: Company revenue series (distinct from merchant GMV).

dimensions.rationale: No retention evidence.
GMV ($1.5B cumulative) is an aggregate growth-adjacent figure, not per-merchant usage telemetry distinct from growth.

dimensions.evidence_used: same merchant-count series as Customer Growth (20k to 80k over ~3 years)
dimensions.rationale: The one case in the whole portfolio where real, applicable multi-period evidence exists for this dimension -- but every parameter this dimension needs (materiality floor, business-model-aware window, expansion-vs-logo distinguishing logic) is unspecified per the specification. This is the cleanest possible demonstration that the blocker here is the missing conversion function, not evidence absence.
dimensions.missing_information: Materiality floor, window function, expansion-vs-logo distinguishing logic -- all CALIBRATION REQUIRED per spec Part 2/7.

dimensions.rationale: No revenue/concentration data (only GMV).
